sources.description: According to the Denver Gazette’s Chris Tomasson, the Denver Broncos had a formal interview with Toledo safety Emmanuel McNeil-Warren at the NFL Scouting Combine. He is viewed as a potential first-round pick in the 2026 NFL Draft and was recently mocked to the Broncos by Mel Kiper Jr. McNeil Warren is a 6-2, 202-pound safety […]
